comment: CtcP is a flavin-dependent halogenase involved in the biosynthesis of the antibiotic chlortetracycline.

changelog.comment: New entry. Fixed reaction SMARTS and added additional comments.

reactions.description: CtcP catalyzes the regioselective C-7 chlorination of the tetracycline scaffold to produce chlortetracycline. 4-epi-tetracyclin (4R) is a non-substrate.
Chlorination of the (4S) tetracycline as last step in the chlortetracyclin biosynthetic pathway.
